name: Rosie 1430 V1
revision_source: Public Rosie 1430 model, 2026-11-22: the geometry, limits and gearing of the Rosie 1430 arms in service. Reductions 100/100/100/18/100/100 with J6 at 100:1 (owner, 2026-11-13). Signs and encoder batteries are per arm; see README.md.

calibration.note: No anchors are embedded. Legacy Home records must not be imported as native Home evidence.

joints.name: J1

gear_ratio.numerator_source: Reductions 100/100/100/18/100/100 with J6 at 100:1, the current Rosie 1430 gearbox (owner, 2026-11-13); a software ratio, not read back from a drive. 131072 motor counts/rev, the A6-EC (AS715N) encoder. See README.md.
gear_ratio.denominator_source: Reductions 100/100/100/18/100/100 with J6 at 100:1, the current Rosie 1430 gearbox (owner, 2026-11-13); a software ratio, not read back from a drive. 131072 motor counts/rev, the A6-EC (AS715N) encoder. See README.md.

joints.encoder_battery_source: Recorded present, as on the Rosie 1430 arms in service. Confirm each arm's encoder batteries and cables before relying on multi-turn Home across a power cycle.
joints.sign_source: All -1, as on the Rosie 1430 arms in service; a sign belongs to an arm's drive wiring, not to the model. Check each joint's direction with a slow joint jog before any Cartesian work on a new arm. See README.md.
